note: Both sets cover the same core facts (grade level and finished floor datums, the five-row revision block, project name, lot 116, and section scales) and both repeat several facts under multiple names. Set B additionally captures the A1 / SECTION - EAST MODULE scale at 3/8" = 1'-0", which Set A omits entirely, and its Finished Floor claims correctly tie the 2'-9 1/2" datum to each section. Set A introduces a unit misread by rendering the scale as 'inches per foot' and mislabels section C1 as a 'Drawing'. Set B's extra section-specific conditions for Finished Floor are supported by the labels shown in both sections, so they are not invented.
remarks: Both extractions triple-state the Grade Level and Finished Floor elevations and repeat the C1 scale two to three times (as 'Drawing C1', 'Section C1', and 'SECTION - WEST MODULE'); deduplication would help. Set A's scale unit 'inches per foot' is a misreading of the graphic scale 3/8" = 1'-0". Neither set captures the sheet number A-301 or sheet title as claims, though both are administration/title-block content.
